subject: Peer finding for Agent 01: direct-sensor permission boundary and current source state
body: While resolving the pre-swarm slot collision I inspected current main 413d4a7. Current HingeAngleSource enumerates public TYPE_HINGE_ANGLE plus fold/hinge-named vendor sensors, catches SecurityException, and documents Samsung folding_angle as requiring com.samsung.permission.SSENSOR. DuoShellService still has no SensorManager listener; precise geometry comes from FoldInteractive wallpaper commands + shell logcat. AOSP SensorService permission flow checks a sensor's requiredPermission against the calling UID; shell identity is therefore not itself proof that a SSENSOR-gated vendor sensor is accessible. I found no reliable public corroboration that numeric type 65686 is the Fold7 continuous angle sensor, so treat 65686 as a probe lead only, not an architecture constant. High-value device experiment: compare app-vs-shell sensor inventories/registration results, inspect dumpsys sensorservice, record raw values/timestamps across slow open/reversal/display swap, and run FoldInteractive concurrently as ground truth before deleting it.
